name: RPG Plus
author: ct
description: Content of the RPG Plus sample (collection rpg_plus), built on top of the RPG demo instead of beside it: a visual-novel prologue at a crossroads where the player picks the hero's class (warrior, mage, rogue: stats_base archetypes) and starting gear, and makes a first charisma check; then the whole rpg_demo village and forest, untouched, with a trainer and a fortune teller added through this mod's own map_events file, a training yard novel scene with exp and a strength check, the merchant selling the classic pack's gear (a shop patch), the wolf given stats (a character patch). Only data and scenarios, no C#.
